# Jev Buddy: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code 7ad86e8afbf3 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** The friendly developer guide to Jev, the AI decision model: choice, noul and score explained with code, business examples, a playground and a cost calculator.
**Live:** https://jev-buddy.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/jev-buddy · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `jev-buddy/.claude/skills/jevbuddy/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py jevbuddy` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms vs engine.** Pages, menus, lists (RepeatingPanels + `Items/`), the hardware picker, the playground editor and
  the Save dialog are Forms. The engine stays JavaScript, moved unchanged: `theme/assets/jb.js` (window.JB: code blocks
  with tabs + Copy, highlighter, answer cards, probability bars, confidence formulas, `JB.simulate` = keyword overlap,
  NOT Jev, `JB.gen` code generator incl. the Self-hosted tab, `JB.EXAMPLES` = the 12 use cases) and
  `theme/assets/jb-content.js` (the 16 guide chapters `JB.CHAPTERS`/`JB.chapter(id)`, the Open source page's facts and
  long sections `JB.OS`, the landing terminal `JB.hero`). Edit chapter or open-source text there.
- **`client_code/jb.py`** is Python's door to the engine (data crosses as JSON, never JS proxies) and holds the
  playground's draft rules (`from_map`, `to_req`, `problems`, `blank`), ported from the JS version.
- **`Components/Rich`** shows engine HTML; its property is `content` (templated Forms use `html` themselves: naming it
  `html` broke every page). `Components/Hero` starts/stops the terminal animation on show/hide.
- **Browser storage** keeps the old keys (`jevbuddy.pg_draft`, `read`, `lang`, `ex_cat`, `cost`, `thr`, `theme`), read
  with `jb.store_get/store_set`. Examples and recipes hand a request to the playground through `pg_draft`
  (`JB.toPlayground`).
- **Live runs** are unchanged server code (Jev.py `run_live`, `jev_status`; Admin → Jev API picks OpenRouter or the
  admin's own open-source server). The playground falls back to the simulator with a note when a live run fails.
- **Router extras**: `page.start()` runs after open_form (Learn's read-tracking observer, Opensource's
  `#opensource/<section>` scroll, the playground's Ctrl+Enter); `page.leave()` stops them. `router.title()` sets
  chapter / use-case titles.
- **Global clicks in engine HTML**: jb.js handles `[data-go]` and `[data-feedback]` (links inside chapters).
- Validator workarounds: `jb.loose(x)` for dynamic dicts/components; server `changes: dict`, `fields: dict`,
  `getattr(anvil.server, "session")` (behaviour unchanged). The browser's Python has no `nonlocal`.
- Facelift: eyebrows, gradient hero text, radial glows, one-side borders and the pulsing dot removed; motion on the kit
  tokens; small print raised to 12px; `--c-faint` darkened (light) / lightened (dark) for AA. Fonts kept (identity).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **jev_runs**: user→users, created:dt, questions:num, input_tokens:num, cost:num, ms:num, ok:bool, error:str · used in Jev
- **recipe_likes**: user→users, recipe→recipes, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Recipes
- **recipes**: owner→users, title:str, summary:str, category:str, state:str, questions:obj, is_public:bool, hidden:bool, likes:num, forks:num, forked_from→recipes, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Recipes
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
